svg.text: Make a noticeable difference to an outcome or
A nicer logo is useful, but faster customer
support would really move the needle.
Informal, common in business. Usually followed
by context about what improves. It can sound
vague unless you name the outcome you care
A: Which improvement should we prioritize?
B: Shorter wait times would move the needle on
A: How would we know they made a difference?
B: We could compare satisfaction scores before
Use the expression while naming a concrete
result, such as completion rate or customer
